source.rule: A five-block bridge functions if any of UL+UR, LL+LR, UL+BR+LR, or LL+BR+UR functions.

configuration.common: Accepted G07.var01 five-position physical system, LRU installations, B/A OPHOURS failure modes, half-hour direct system CM, G04-OPS mode, h8–34 mission, seed1, one replication and horizon36. Every arm changes only RBDBridge slot IDs/description and ProblemDescription.

configuration.lllr: B=UL, A=BR; C=LL, D=LR, E=UR; after B/A only LL+LR remains.
configuration.ulbrlr: B=UR, A=LL; C=UL, D=BR, E=LR; after B/A only UL+BR+LR remains.
configuration.accepted_parent: B=UL, A=LR; C=LL, D=UR, E=BR; after B/A only LL+BR+UR remains.
configuration.allbroken: B=UL, A=LL; C=UR, D=LR, E=BR; after B/A all four paths are broken.

pre_run_hypotheses: All four new arms import, roundtrip and calculate without converter errors or unreviewed diagnostics.

The same B and A failure identities/times occur across the four new arms and accepted parent. B first is noncritical in all; A remains noncritical and the mission succeeds in each single-path arm, while A is critical and the mission aborts in the all-broken arm.

The source-bound truth table has exactly one functional bridge path after B/A in each unique-path arm and zero in allbroken; the native event log may show only system criticality, not the active path label.

Each arm exact populated-table import/export roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Matched B/A events with expected A criticality and mission outcome, 72-bin report/CM/stock/terminal reconciliation, and independent read-only replay separate from author code.

limits: Five fixed-seed B/A failure patterns including the accepted parent, with physical A/B identity reassigned to bridge slots; other failure combinations, simultaneous transitions, and population reliability remain unverified.
